name: Hugenotten- und Waldenserpfad (Hauptweg - Teilstrecke Frankfurt - Braunfels)
description_md:
The Hugenotten- und Waldenserpfad (Hauptweg - Teilstrecke Frankfurt - Braunfels) is a waymarked hiking route in Germany spanning 83.2 km. It is signposted as HuWa and forms part of the national waymarked hiking network.

The route features 1499 m of ascent and 1347 m of descent, requiring about 25 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule. This hard route is classified using difficulty derived from distance and ascent. Along the way, the path passes Frankfurt within 400 m, Deutsche Bank within 800 m, and Senckenberganlage within 1900 m.
